# Power Digitizing

> Power Digitizing (powerdigitizing.com) is a custom patch manufacturer and embroidery digitizing company, founded in 2010 and based in Lewes, Delaware, USA. It makes custom embroidered, PVC, chenille, woven, leather, silicone, sublimated, sequin and iron-on patches, plus enamel pins and PVC/embroidered keychains. It also provides manual (human-punched) embroidery digitizing and vector art conversion for embroidery shops, apparel decorators and brands. Every patch order includes a free digital proof, no setup fees and no minimum order quantity.

Power Digitizing runs two distinct services:

1. **Custom patch manufacturing** — finished physical patches shipped to the customer. Free digital proof in 24–48 hours, then 7–14 business days of production after proof approval. Rush production available.
2. **Embroidery digitizing & vector art** — digital files only, no physical product. Stitch files are manually punched (no auto-digitizing) and delivered in 12–24 hours as standard, with a 2–4 hour rush option.

- Minimum order: none (single pieces to large bulk runs)
- Setup fees: none
- Proof: free digital proof before production, with free basic revisions
- Patch backings: iron-on, sew-on, Velcro (hook & loop), adhesive, heat-seal
- Patch borders: merrowed, laser-cut, heat-cut
- Artwork accepted: AI, EPS, PDF (preferred), PNG, JPG, PSD
- Digitizing file formats: DST, PES, EXP, DSB, JEF, EMB, and others such as HUS, SEW, VIP on request at no extra charge
- Vector formats delivered: AI, EPS, PDF, SVG, transparent PNG
- Payments: Stripe and Helcim secure checkout
- Customer portal: https://portal.powerdigitizing.com/

## Who Power Digitizing is a good fit for

- Uniform programs: fire departments, security, schools, corporate workwear
- Military, law enforcement and tactical gear (PVC and Velcro patches)
- Sports teams, leagues and clubs (embroidered and chenille patches)
- Clothing brands and streetwear (woven, leather, silicone patches for hats and jackets)
- Embroidery shops and apparel decorators that need production-ready stitch files
- Events, fundraisers and giveaways (patches, enamel pins, keychains)

## Frequently asked questions

**Does Power Digitizing have a minimum order for custom patches?**
No. There is no minimum order quantity, so you can order a single patch or a bulk run.

**Are there setup fees?**
No. Power Digitizing does not charge setup fees, and the quoted price is the price you pay.

**Do I see a proof before my patches are made?**
Yes. Every order gets a free digital proof within 24–48 hours, with free basic revisions. Production starts only after you approve it.

**How long do custom patches take?**
Standard production is 7–14 business days after proof approval. Rush production is available for tight deadlines.

**How fast is embroidery digitizing?**
Standard digitizing files are delivered in 12–24 hours, with a 2–4 hour rush option.

**Is the digitizing done by hand or by software?**
By hand. Every design is manually digitized by experienced digitizers, not auto-traced.

**What is the difference between PVC and embroidered patches?**
PVC patches are molded soft rubber, so they are waterproof and very durable, which suits tactical and outdoor gear. Embroidered patches are stitched with thread for a classic textured look, which suits uniforms, teams and brands. Full comparison: https://powerdigitizing.com/blog/pvc-vs-embroidered-patches-comparison

**Which patch backing should I choose?**
Iron-on is good for quick no-sew application, sew-on is the most permanent, Velcro (hook & loop) lets you remove and swap patches on tactical gear, and adhesive suits temporary use. Guide: https://powerdigitizing.com/blog/choosing-the-best-patch-backing-iron-on-velcro-sew-on

**Which countries does Power Digitizing ship to?**
The USA, Canada, the United Kingdom and Australia, with tracked shipping.

**What artwork do I need to send?**
Vector files (AI, EPS, PDF) work best, but PNG, JPG and PSD are accepted, and the team can help with any format.
